text.en: Recent reviewers express dissatisfaction with front-desk interactions at the Rubery branch, describing communication as dismissive during difficult moments. A client noted reluctance to assist when discussing benefit assistance, while another recounted being asked to wait outside in cold weather. Visitors report feeling unwelcome during visits.

q.en: Where is Townsend Veterinary Centre in Rubery located?

a.en: The clinic is located on New Road in Rubery, Birmingham, offering local veterinary consultations and care.

q.en: What concerns do recent client reviews highlight?

a.en: Recent feedback focuses on reception communication and waiting arrangements, with several visitors expressing disappointment.

q.en: How can pet owners arrange an appointment?

a.en: Pet owners can contact the surgery by telephone to schedule consultations, health checks, and routine treatments.
